insights.one_liner: Lab testing group doing environment, food and pharma research in the Netherlands; its Dutch lab entity is an IND recognised sponsor and its jobs don't need Dutch.

culture.text: Focused on high-quality lab research and project support in environment, food and pharma.
Its 4 open jobs here are in Breda, Amersfoort and Nijmegen, mainly life sciences, including one internship.

open.text: Eurofins Analytico B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
All 4 open jobs here don't ask for Dutch, and 1 of 4 mentions visa or relocation.
